shows.title: American Horror Story
shows.overview: American Horror Story is an anthology horror drama series created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk. The Emmy® and Golden Globe® winning franchise is produced by Twentieth Century Fox Television.

shows.title: Chicago P.D.
shows.overview: Chicago P.D.'s Intelligence Unit investigates threats and adapts to an ever-changing criminal justice system. Catch new episodes first on NBC.

shows.title: Hell's Kitchen
shows.overview: Renowned restaurateur Gordon Ramsay hosts a fierce competition for aspiring chefs, as they vie for a prestigious job at one of his eateries.

shows.title: Tougen Anki
shows.overview: After his father is murdered, a rebellious teen discovers his Oni ancestry and enters an academy to hone his powers in the secret demon-hero war.

shows.title: Beyond the Gates
shows.overview: Beyond the Gates follows the powerful Dupree family, whose wealth and prestige conceal generations of secrets, scandals, and hidden tensions.

shows.title: Let's Make a Deal
shows.overview: Costumed contestants compete for cash and prizes.

shows.title: Carrie
shows.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

shows.title: Coronation Street
shows.overview: Soap opera set in the fictional town of Weatherfield, centered on the lives and loves of the people living in and around Coronation Street. Strong female characters, dramatic storylines and humour combine to make this unmissable viewing.

shows.title: Antiques Roadshow
shows.overview: Everyday people bring out their extraordinary treasures for experts to examine. Who will bring a pricey artifact that will change their life forever?

shows.title: The Bold and the Beautiful
shows.overview: The seductive story of Brooke Logan Forrester, the ex-wife of three of the Forrester Men- Eric, Ridge, and Thorne.

shows.title: This Old House
shows.overview: In this long-running, award-winning series, home improvement experts offer trusted information and advice on renovations, repairs, and more.

shows.title: Masha and the Bear
shows.overview: A mischievous girl causes chaos in the forest, forcing a grumpy bear to become her reluctant parent through incredible and hilarious adventures.

shows.title: Masterplan
shows.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him - Chiara, an Italian cybercrime expert and Jay, a French explosives specialist - before revealing he is both their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion, this new family must learn to work together and try not to kill each other if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

shows.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
shows.overview: From practical jokes to home improvement plans gone awry, to animal mishaps and just flat out strange behavior, this hilarious show on ABC pulls out all the stops to present everyday people caught on tape in their most embarrassing moments!

shows.title: Love of Your Life
shows.overview: Directed by Rachel Morrison (The Fire Inside), LOVE OF YOUR LIFE follows Maya (Margaret Qualley), whose chance encounter with Charlie (Gabriel Basso) sets in motion a sweeping romance and a future beyond what she imagined. When that future is upended, Maya is sent hurtling toward an unexpected new life-one that will force her to reckon with who she is, what she wants, and how to love again.

shows.title: EastEnders
shows.overview: The residents of Albert Square compel audiences with a blend of the everyday and the surprising.

shows.title: Marília Mendonça: All the Feels
shows.overview: How did an ordinary girl from the heart of Brazil become a phenomenon? Through previously unreleased footage, audio recordings and interviews, the series traces Marília Mendonça's meteoric rise from singing at a gas station to becoming one of Brazil's biggest artists.

shows.title: Neagley
shows.overview: From the world of REACHER, a new chapter begins. Frances Neagley (Maria Sten) is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

shows.title: Friends Sex and Games
shows.overview: Four couples. One sexy game. Anna's first love is back - and at a reunion party, they're suddenly staring at a bowl of keys: draw one and spend the night with its owner. No strings. No feelings. Is that even possible? Trust, jealousy, hidden desires, hilarious moments - and seriously hot sex. The game unleashes more than anyone bargained for and everyone tries to answer: what truly makes me happy?
